notes: Libretto by Lorenzo Da Ponte (1786). Words follow the engraving's spelling (quà, quì, sà, nò, da for dà, si for sì in 'si barbaro' and 'si gran torto', scola, commune, mertan/merta, vo', vel/ve'l, nol, cos' è, un', femminee; anima is printed split as 'ani ma', and 'mai tremiti' stands for ma i tremiti). IPA follows sung Italian conventions: stressed syllable marked, elisions (two words on one note in the score) joined with ‿, open e/o as ɛ/ɔ, intervocalic s voiced, così with [s] as in the model; 'ani ma' is sung a.ni‿ma, 'mai' in m. 258 as one syllable (ma i). Translation literal, for meaning.
